key: # The Area 09 Archives Committee's collections (msca09aa-archives.org), one row per Google Drive folder or file it links to. mode = files: every file in it is listed in the site's document library next to the Area's own documents (scripts/archives-index.mjs re-reads the folder once a day, so new files the Archives add appear by themselves); link = shown as one collection card that opens the Archives' folder; off = not shown. category = the library shelf (data/document-categories.csv key). district = district slug for group histories. The Archives keep these folders up to date; never copy their files into the Area's Drive (MSCA09AA/MSCA09AA-archives holds shortcuts only).
